articles.title: Complaint filed to medical regulator over MP saying fentanyl ‘readily available’ in MAID report
articles.summary: TORONTO — Remarks made by a member of Parliament, who is also a doctor, suggesting illicit drugs such as fentanyl are a “painless” and “readily available” option to end one’s life are now the subject of a complaint filed to the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario.

articles.title: Police search for man in alleged Moss Park sexual assault
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for man after someone was allegedly sexually assaulted inside a Moss Park apartment early Friday.

articles.title: Police in Peel Region warn of ‘high-risk’ offender released back into community
articles.summary: Police in Peel Region have issued a public safety advisory following the release of a "high-risk" offender back into the community.

articles.title: Police release video of vehicles in area before fatal hit and run in Vaughan
articles.summary: Police have released new video of three vehicles in the area where a woman was fatally struck in a Vaughan hit and run on the weekend, saying they're hoping to speak to the drivers.

articles.title: Oshawa mayoral candidates focus on homelessness, downtown concerns at debate
articles.summary: Candidates shared plans to tackle homelessness and revitalize downtown Oshawa during Thursday's debate, hosted by the Greater Oshawa Chamber of Commerce at the Bond St. Event Centre.

articles.title: Ontario will officially begin removing Toronto bike lanes on Tuesday
articles.summary: Ontario will begin removing bike lanes from a stretch on Bloor Street W. in Etobicoke on Tuesday, the Ministry of Transportation says.
